name: Doubled Stride
description: Cast a double one stride ahead and trade places with it in a single soft step.

name: Offset Echo
description: Set an echo slightly off the user's true line so that an opponent aims a hand's breadth wide.

name: Guarding Double
description: Stand the double at the user's side where it meets any soul-strike aimed at the user's flank.

name: Brisk Shade
description: Whip a brisk shade across an opponent's guard so that a sharp jolt of soul force follows the touch.

name: Listening Double
description: Leave the double standing a few paces off to listen to the soul-field and warn the user of any soul that nears.

name: Crossing Image
description: Throw the image across an opponent's line and follow it past the guard so that the user lands a soul-blow from the blind side.

name: Twin Rend
description: Strike with user and double together so that two blows of soul force meet on one opponent at the same instant.

name: Waiting Effigy
description: Leave an effigy standing where the user was so that a hostile soul-strike falls on it first.

name: Sleeping Likeness
description: Let a likeness lie as if asleep so that an opponent holds back from a body that seems unready.

name: Flat Reflection
description: Tilt a flat reflection of the user into the path of a soul-bolt so that the bolt turns aside.

name: Parting Shade
description: Leave a parting shade behind and step backward out of reach while the shade holds the opponent's eye.

name: Poised Husk
description: Raise a husk of the user's own shape that blocks a soul-strike and returns a sharp jolt along the line it came from.

name: Springing Effigy
description: Let a waiting effigy spring at the first hostile soul that crosses it and hit that soul with a stunning jolt.

name: Veiled Pair
description: Cast two copies of the user at once so that an opponent faces three figures and cannot name the true one.

name: Opposed Step
description: Move a step and let a copy move the opposite way so that the opponent follows the wrong one.

name: Gauze Twin
description: Spread a gauze twin before the user to catch a soul-lash and turn it away.

name: Counting Shade
description: Send a shade round the area to count the souls within it and mark the strongest.

name: Prodding Copy
description: Prod an opponent's soul with a copy's hand so that a small shock breaks the opponent's stride.

name: Pairing Switch
description: Switch the true body with one of the pair in mid stride so that the opponent's counter lands on empty soul.

name: Clearing Echo
description: Lay a clean echo over an ally and wash out a lingering daze or false fear that a hostile soul has left behind.

name: Echo Retinue
description: Raise a ring of small echoes round the user so that a soul-strike is shared out among them.

name: Marching Doubles
description: Send several doubles forward in step so that the opponent loses track of the true body among them.

name: Quick Attendant
description: Let a quick attendant echo dart in at an opponent and rap the soul before the user closes.

name: Scattered Presence
description: Scatter the user's presence into small echoes and gather it again a few steps away.

name: Murmuring Chorus
description: Let each echo murmur what it meets so that the user hears the whole soul-field as one report.

name: Shared Weight
description: Spread the weight of an incoming soul-strike across every echo of the retinue so that none of them nor the user bears it whole.

name: Retinue Charge
description: Drive the whole retinue at once into the opponents ahead so that a wave of small soul-strikes breaks over them.

name: Wandering Likeness
description: Let a likeness wander out from the body on a thread and read the souls it passes.

name: Thread Image
description: Hold a thread image before the user as a screen that the thread keeps whole against a soul-strike.

name: Rival Figure
description: Set a rival figure at the edge of an opponent's sight so that the opponent turns to face a threat that is not there.

name: Threaded Reach
description: Stretch the likeness out along its thread to touch a distant opponent with a thin lash of soul force.

name: Reeled Return
description: Reel the likeness home along its thread and let the pull draw the user a stride after it.

name: Muffled Visitor
description: Let the likeness pass among strangers as a muffled visitor so that no soul-sense marks it as the user's.

name: Sundered Tether
description: Snap the likeness across an opponent's soul-technique so that the opponent's grip on it breaks apart.

name: Distant Judgment
description: Drive a narrow line of soul force down the thread so that it reaches an opponent past the guard of the body.
